entities.summary: Michael Patrick Driscoll was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as the seventh bishop of the Diocese of Boise in Idaho from 1999 to 2014. Driscoll previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Orange in California from 1990 to 1999.
